description: This file is a shell script named 'release.sh' which implements a manual release version bump tool. It automates tasks such as analyzing commits since a specified reference, mapping changes to components via metadata files, deciding version bumps based on labels and heuristics, and optionally applying updates to metadata.yaml files. It also supports integration with GitHub for PR label retrieval when available.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints error messages to stderr and exits the script.

methods.name: component_from_path
methods.description: Determines the component directory from a given file path based on the list of component metadata files.

methods.name: is_doc_like_path
methods.description: Determines if a given file path is documentation-like, used to infer if a change is docs-only.

methods.name: get_pr_for_commit
methods.description: Retrieves the PR number associated with a given commit SHA, optionally via GitHub API.

methods.name: get_pr_labels
methods.description: Fetches labels associated with a PR on GitHub.

methods.name: compute_next_versions
methods.description: Calculates the next version and generation numbers based on current version, generation, and bump type.

methods.name: update_metadata
methods.description: Updates the version and generation fields in a component's metadata.yaml file.
